name: Star Mica Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Star Mica Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the renovated condominium, investment, and advisory businesses in Japan. The company engages in investment, renovation, sale, and brokerage of pre-owned condominiums; and real estate leasing, planning, management, and brokerage activities. It also offers private banking and investment advisory services. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
